paragraphs: Adda Mari—so it should read. “Rav said” (an error), “Adda bar” (an error) “Mari said in Rabbi Nechemyah bar Barukh’s name, in Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin’s name, in Rabbi Yehudah’s name,” Mo'ed Katan 16a. Zevachim 38a: Rava said, “Bar Adda Mari explained to me.” In the Arukh: Adda Mari like Abba Mari (I did not find it). Rashi, Bameh Ishah, likewise reads Abba Mari, not Adda Mari, and says this was his name. Shabbat 26b: Adda Mari said in Rabbi Nachman bar Barukh’s name, in Rabbi Ashi bar Avin’s name, in Rav Yehudah’s name.
